title: 暗神话:露西
description:
In a deserted city from the Middle Ages, many mutated zombies appeared. The army had previously developed gas here. The higher-ups were worried that the zombies would invade the surrounding cities, so they sent Lucy to investigate the situation. It would be best to eliminate all the mutated zombies. The higher-ups gave Lucy 6 high-tech weapons, but there were simply too many zombies here. Lucy might have to stay here for a long time. Get ready. The mission begins!

 

 You need to control Lucy to kill the zombies around her. After killing the zombies, you will gain experience. When the experience is sufficient for upgrading, you will have the chance to enhance your attributes. However, each time you die, one of your random attributes will be reduced in level. Therefore, you need to choose the most suitable attribute to enhance. The weapon is an automatic attack and doesn't require any operation. You just need to control Lucy's movement.

 

 • Use the WSAD keys to control the character's movement, and use the mouse to control the view. 

• Automatic attack, no need to manually initiate the attack. 

• gradually upgrade and enhance attributes.

 

 • Smooth and excellent third-person controller. 

• Background music that is in line with the theme (BGM). 

• Gradual achievements unlock. 

• Experience the sense of achievement that comes from solving the puzzle. 

• Unlimited game time, getting stronger all the time.
description_short: In a deserted city from the Middle Ages, many mutated zombies appeared. The army had previously developed poisonous gas here. The higher-ups were worried that the zombies would invade the surrounding cities, so they sent Lucy to investigate the situation.
